jobs.list.title: List jobs
jobs.list.description: List public job postings via GET /v1/boards/{boardToken}/jobs.

jobs.get.title: Get job
jobs.get.description: Fetch a single Harvest job via authenticated GET /v1/jobs/{id}. Distinct from boards jobs.list.

candidates.list.title: List candidates
candidates.list.description: List candidates via authenticated Harvest GET /v1/candidates. Optional perPage, page, createdBefore/After, updatedBefore/After, jobId, email, and candidateIds filters.

candidates.get.title: Get candidate
candidates.get.description: Fetch a single candidate via authenticated Harvest GET /v1/candidates/{id}.

applications.list.title: List applications
applications.list.description: List applications via authenticated Harvest GET /v1/applications. Optional perPage, page, createdBefore/After, lastActivityAfter, jobId, and status filters.

users.list.title: List users
users.list.description: List users via authenticated Harvest GET /v1/users. Optional perPage, page, email, employeeId, and created/updated before/after filters.

interviews.list.title: List interviews
interviews.list.description: List scheduled interviews via authenticated Harvest GET /v1/scheduled_interviews. Optional perPage, page, applicationId, jobId, and created/updated before/after filters.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Validate Greenhouse Harvest credentials with GET /users?per_page=1.
